annotations.title: Email address verification: deliverability signals without sending mail

description: Verify an email address without sending mail: syntax, domain and MX records, disposable and free providers, role addresses, SPF and DMARC presence, with a verdict (likely-deliverable, risky, undeliverable, invalid) and reasons. DNS and syntax signals only: the mailbox itself is not contacted, so this is not proof that a mailbox exists. Use before sending mail, saving a signup or scoring a lead. Example: address=support@cloudflare.com. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
